blockers.text: OWNER DECISION: whether the manual contract signature registration and the manual distribution confirmation must record real evidence (a signed file with a hash; what was confirmed, by whom, when). Needs the asset layer and the submission model (schema). Covers criterion 'a status update to signed without a provider signature record is rejected' and 'a plain status update to distributed is rejected', which are not satisfied and were not forced.

OWNER DECISION: closed list of Work participant roles (the web offers more roles and stored data uses them) and whether a registry share may carry both a work and a phonogram (existing contract tests treat the pair as valid). Covers the two R-CAT-6 criteria that are not satisfied. The criterion that asked for an exact 100% total at write time is superseded by the registry-time check: a Work created from a Project has no formal percentages yet.

EXTERNAL DEPENDENCY: connection probes for providers other than Abramus need a real authenticated call to each provider; saving credentials alone still leaves those integrations recorded as connected but not verified. Covers the first R-CAT-4 criterion for those providers.
EXTERNAL DEPENDENCY: R-CAT-9 referential integrity diagnostics are read-only SQL that cannot be proven without PostgreSQL; not implemented rather than shipped unverified.
